fields.statement: QA at dea4e5b6 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a scratch git repo, fake rex that runs the tab command and a fake claude that sleeps: rhiza run start --foreground --workflow plan --new 'Backlog empty' --milestone gave OSC 7501 states working, blocked, done on stderr, the blocked msg decoding to '<cs>: interview waits on you in tab <session>: the milestone interview waits on you', emitted before the agent asked anything; a feature plan run and a --milestone --autonomous run gave only working, done. The run's journal carries milestone_plan:true only for the milestone run.

QA at dea4e5b6, built binary, fake rex/claude: while a non-autonomous milestone plan run's interview was live, rhiza inbox listed one 'interview' item naming the run, change set and title, tab 'repo: Backlog empty · run <id> · interview', block/session of the tab and 'the milestone interview waits on you'; rhiza inbox open <id> ran rex block inspect then rex focus on that tab's block; after the run ended the inbox was empty; feature and autonomous milestone runs gave no item. rhiza daemon --once with the interview live sent one blocked Rex report 'Backlog empty: a milestone interview waits on you'; a second --once sent none.

QA at dea4e5b6, built binary, real detached runs with fake rex/claude: with rhiza.daemon.usage.session 1000 and a Claude transcript of 2000 tokens, a queued feature and a queued milestone request: paused, daemon --once started neither; --min-free 1000T (disk low) started neither; unpaused under the usage-reserve hold (inbox lists usage-reserve) it started only the milestone request's plan run and request ls showed the feature still queued.

QA at dea4e5b6, built binary, fake rex/claude, real detached runs: with --max-runs 1 and a feature request's plan run already live, queuing a second feature then a milestone request, daemon --once started only the milestone request's plan run and request ls showed the second feature still queued; with one milestone interview live a second milestone request stayed queued after the next daemon --once.
